integrity: Proof supplied for the full claimed range. Finite verification is supplementary, not a proof of an all-order assertion. Standard canonical threshold coding is credited to earlier sources.
scientific_limitations: Unlabeled connected threshold graphs only. This does not negate the general connected-graph or chordal symmetry and does not solve the open bijection problem. An earlier unindexed joint enumerator cannot be excluded by a search.
title: A sharp symmetry failure and exact sibling–tuft census for connected threshold graphs
